review_kind: author semantic analysis, not independent proof or owner acceptance

coverage.why_not_a_formal_pass: Declared semantic questions and example distinctions are evidence for review; no mechanized source interpretation or proof has executed.

comparisons.existing_question: What one term normatively means in a scope.
comparisons.distinction_example: A Pack can contain only existing references and an open question; it creates no new Definition.

comparisons.existing_question: Which selected information a request/view includes from an exact context/source epoch.
comparisons.distinction_example: A Pack additionally records required-concept handling and proposals/gaps. A Context View can exist without such handling.

comparisons.existing_question: What an attributable assessment concludes against declared criteria.
comparisons.distinction_example: The Pack is a semantic input to assessment and can exist before any reviewer acts.

comparisons.existing_question: Which exact governance effect requests are presented together.
comparisons.distinction_example: The Pack can be reviewed with zero requested admission effects; conceptual handling is not effect selection.

comparisons.existing_question: What supporting/counterevidence is assembled for one claim/question.
comparisons.distinction_example: A Pack also declares concept dispositions and unresolved meaning; collecting evidence alone does not select dispositions.

comparisons.existing_question: Which owner-governed expressions/rules constitute a bounded context language.
comparisons.distinction_example: A Pack freezes a particular required subset and handling state for one use, without establishing the whole language.

comparisons.existing_question: What an explicit governed representation models.
comparisons.distinction_example: Pack is a narrower bundle contract under the generic governed-representation idea; overlap does not make its specific handling question redundant.

comparisons.existing_question: How governed identifiable entries are ordered, maintained and reconciled.
comparisons.distinction_example: A frozen Pack need not be an ordered correction/reconciliation ledger; a Ledger can preserve successive Packs.

comparisons.existing_question: How exact canonical inputs and a governed generator produce reproducible output.
comparisons.distinction_example: A Pack can be authored; being produced by a tool does not establish the Generated Output contract or a second authority.

additional_review_obligations: Check all current normative statements under the selected interpretation/impact scope, not labels only.
Review consumer/supplement/profile consequences and interpretation fidelity.
Keep role/scope/authority/reference currentness axes independent; explicit constraints do not transfer approval.
